input_observations.scope: Local send to observed authority acknowledgement and present return; not physical touch-to-photon latency.

legacy_rate_scope: The lifetime native_ticks_per_second includes waiting; use active_battle for active authoritative speed.

budget.scope: Local display only; input/network/authority update every service iteration

presentation.interval_scope: presentation_interval_actual: completed displays; frame_interval_actual: service loop

scheduling.note: Budget yields occur after complete room steps; one step can exceed budget. authority_sim + authority_room_overhead + authority_refresh are disjoint; room_update/refresh include them, do not sum both sets.
